You have a CA patent or application number (from search_patents or a CPD URL) and need its bibliographic data, status, abstract, history or document list.

include_text.description: Also return the full claims and description text (can be tens of kilobytes).

language.description:
Interface language of the summary page (labels such as status, event descriptions and fee types). Titles and abstracts are always returned in both languages when the record has them.

Provider reference: allowed values ["en", "fr"]; default "en".

patent_number.description: CA patent or application number, digits only or prefixed with `CA` (e.g. `2553707`, `CA 3110539`).

url.description: A CPD patent page URL (`.../opic-cipo/cpd/eng/patent/<number>/summary.html` or the French `.../fra/brevet/<number>/sommaire.html`) instead of `patent_number`.

200.description:
The full public record of one Canadian patent or application from its CPD summary page: kind (patent or application), English and French titles, status, IPC codes, inventors, owners, applicants and agents, filing/issue/publication/OPI/examination dates, licence and dedication flags, PCT and priority data, English and French abstracts, representative drawing URL, administrative event history, fee history, current and past owners on record, and the list of viewable documents. Claims and description text are included on request (`include_text`). PDF downloads are behind a reCAPTCHA and are not provided.

The response contains the tool result directly.

value.abstract_en: A negative electrode of a lithium secondary battery having a mixture layer containing graphite particles and an organic binder on a current collector, wherein the diffraction intensity ratio (002)/(110) of the mixture layer measured by X-ray diffraction is not higher than 500, and a lithium secondary battery having that negative electrode and a positive electrode containing a lithium compound. Since the quick charge/discharge characteristics and the cycle characteristics do not deteriorate significantly when the negative electrode density of the lithium secondary battery is increased, a high- capacity lithium secondary battery having an enhanced energy density per volume of secondary battery can be provided.
value.abstract_fr: La présente invention a trait à une électrode négative pour un accumulateur au lithium comportant une couche de mélange contenant des particules de graphite et un liant organique sur un collecteur de courant, dans laquelle le rapport d'intensité de diffraction (002)/(110) de la couche de mélange mesurée par diffraction de rayons X est égale ou inférieure à 500, et un accumulateur au lithium comportant cette électrode négative et une électrode positive contenant un composé de lithium. Etant donné que les caractéristiques de charge/décharge rapide et les caractéristiques de cycle ne se détériorent pas de manière significative lors de l'accroissement de la densité d'électrode négative de l'accumulateur au lithium, il est possible d'obtenir un accumulateur au lithium haute capacité présentant une densité d'énergie améliorée par volume d'un accumulateur au lithium.

post.description:
Start here to find patent numbers by keyword, title, inventor, applicant or owner name, IPC class, PCT or international publication number, or a date range; then call get_patent with a returned patent_number.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page (the zero-based offset of the next hit). Keep every other input identical. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,5}$.

date_type.description:
Which date the `from_date`/`to_date` range applies to. Requires both dates.

Provider reference: allowed values ["issue-date", "filing-date", "exam-request-date", "publication-date", "priority-date", "national-entry-date", "green-technology-granted-date"].

field.description:
Restrict `query` to one bibliographic field (the CPD advanced-search field list). `intl-number` is the WO international publication number, `pct-number` the PCT filing number.

Provider reference: allowed values ["title", "abstract", "claims", "description", "inventor", "applicant", "current-owner", "owners-on-record", "ipc", "pct-number", "intl-number"].

from_date.description: Inclusive range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Requires `date_type` and `to_date`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

language.description:
Interface language of the results (English or French titles and summary URLs). The query syntax is the same in both.

Provider reference: allowed values ["en", "fr"]; default "en".

page_size.description:
Hits per page (the site serves 10, 25, 50 and 100; any value up to 100 is accepted).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 10.

query.description: Search words, or a raw CPD query expression (`field:(words)`, AND/OR/NOT, `date-field:[YYYY-MM-DD TO YYYY-MM-DD]`). Combined with `field`, only plain words belong here.

search_type.description:
CPD search mode. Default: `basic` for plain words, `advanced` as soon as `field` or a date range is given. Pass `advanced` or `boolean` yourself when `query` is already a fielded expression.

Provider reference: allowed values ["basic", "advanced", "boolean"].

to_date.description: Inclusive range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Requires `date_type` and `from_date`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

200.description:
Search the Canadian Patents Database. Free-text keyword search by default; set `field` to restrict the query to one bibliographic field (title, abstract, claims, inventor, applicant, current-owner, ipc, pct-number, ...), or give a raw CPD query expression such as `title:(solar panel) AND (issue-date:[2020-01-01 TO 2025-12-31])` with `search_type` advanced or boolean. Returns one page of ranked hits (patent number, title, relevance score, summary URL) with the total count and a `next_cursor` for the following page. The site displays at most 5,000 hits per query (`display_limit_exceeded`); narrow broad queries with a date range.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `patent_number` | string | CA patent or application number; the key for get_patent. |
| `rank` | number | 1-based position in the full result list. |
| `score_percent` | number | Relevance score as shown (`98%` -> 98); null when not shown. |
| `source_url` | string | Patent summary page URL. |
| `title` | string | Title in the interface language; null when the site shows no title in that language (older records in the French interface). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
